all: commander.output valid against output.schema.json
commander.output.expected_state_version == context.run.state_version
trigger.run_id == trigger.event.run_id == context.run.run_id
every Incident has unique incident_id and exact context.run run_id, pack_id, pack_version and pack_digest
every Incident.canonical_incident_id is null, itself or resolves to an emitted Incident
Plan has exact context.run run_id, pack_id, pack_version and pack_digest
Plan.status == active
context.plan == null or context.plan.status == active
if context.plan == null then Plan.plan_version == 1 and Plan.supersedes_plan_id == null
if context.plan is active then Plan.plan_version == context.plan.plan_version + 1
if context.plan is active then Plan.plan_id != context.plan.plan_id and Plan.supersedes_plan_id == context.plan.plan_id
every Action has unique action_id and exact context.run run_id, pack_id, pack_version and pack_digest
every Action.action_id is absent from context.actions[].action_id
set(plan.incident_ids) == set(commander.output.incidents[].incident_id)
set(plan.action_ids) == set(commander.output.actions[].action_id)
every Action.plan_id == plan.plan_id
every Action.incident_id resolves to commander.output.incidents[].incident_id

at least one Action has primitive == contact_entity, status == pending_approval, approval_policy == human_required, non-empty string params.mission and params.requested_response in [accept_or_reject, acknowledge]
every signal evidence reference resolves to an active context.signals revision
every incident evidence reference resolves to commander.output.incidents[].incident_id

nodes.name: Validate Retried Plan Proposal Before Write

all: retry_commander.output valid against output.schema.json
retry_commander.output.command_id != commander.output.command_id
retry_commander.output.expected_state_version == retry_context.run.state_version
retry_context.run.state_version > context.run.state_version
trigger.run_id == trigger.event.run_id == retry_context.run.run_id
every retried Incident has unique incident_id and exact retry_context.run run_id, pack_id, pack_version and pack_digest
every retried Incident.canonical_incident_id is null, itself or resolves to a retried Incident
retried Plan has exact retry_context.run run_id, pack_id, pack_version and pack_digest
retried Plan.status == active
retry_context.plan == null or retry_context.plan.status == active
if retry_context.plan == null then retried Plan.plan_version == 1 and retried Plan.supersedes_plan_id == null
if retry_context.plan is active then retried Plan.plan_version == retry_context.plan.plan_version + 1
if retry_context.plan is active then retried Plan.plan_id != retry_context.plan.plan_id and retried Plan.supersedes_plan_id == retry_context.plan.plan_id
every retried Action has unique action_id and exact retry_context.run run_id, pack_id, pack_version and pack_digest
every retried Action.action_id is absent from retry_context.actions[].action_id
set(retried plan.incident_ids) == set(retry_commander.output.incidents[].incident_id)
set(retried plan.action_ids) == set(retry_commander.output.actions[].action_id)
every retried Action.plan_id == retried plan.plan_id
every retried Action.incident_id resolves to retry_commander.output.incidents[].incident_id

at least one retried Action has primitive == contact_entity, status == pending_approval, approval_policy == human_required, non-empty string params.mission and params.requested_response in [accept_or_reject, acknowledge]
every retried signal evidence reference resolves to an active retry_context.signals revision
every retried incident evidence reference resolves to retry_commander.output.incidents[].incident_id
